content: This medication is not available as a single agent. By adding plans, you can compare the formulary status of this drug to other medications within the same therapeutic class. To access formulary information, you must first create a list of plans. This list will be saved and can be modified at any time. Adding plans enables you to perform these comparisons effectively. The information provided here is intended solely for general informational and educational purposes. Please note that individual plans may differ, and formulary details are subject to change. For the most accurate and up-to-date information, it is recommended to contact the relevant plan provider directly. When sending this information to a recipient, they will receive additional details and instructions on how to access the offer.
